tips.text: Tranq the fox, pull a nearby Infested pack over to it, and capture only once its name reads Weakened.
Go invisible with Ivara, Loki or Octavia so the Infested attack the fox instead of you.
Check for Weakened in the name before you capture; a plain capture only gives tags.
Fly in Archwing to spot a spawn fast, then drag the nearest Infested pack back to it.
Mind Control a nearby enemy and release it next to the sleeping fox if no Infested will go near it.
Keep the Tranq Rifle out while mining or running bounties in the Drift at night; random Weakened spawns count.
Skip Steel Path for this; lure-spawned animals come in at level 1 and one hit can kill them instead of weakening.
Look in both the Vulpaphyla and Predasite tabs at Son if a capture seems missing.
Buy the cheapest Mutagen and Antigen pair at Rank 1; any pair gives a Crescent.
Expect the wait for a Crescent to spawn at night to be the only real cost, from minutes to about four hours.
